import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import credentials, auth

def register_user(email, password):
    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        cred = credentials.Certificate('path/to/serviceAccountKey.json')
        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)
    user = auth.create_user(email=email, password=password)
    return user.uid

import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import credentials, auth

def email_password_login(email, password):
    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        cred = credentials.Certificate('path/to/serviceAccountKey.json')
        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)
    user = auth.get_user_by_email(email)
    custom_token = auth.create_custom_token(user.uid)
    return custom_token

import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import credentials, auth

def refresh_session(refresh_token):
    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        cred = credentials.Certificate('path/to/serviceAccountKey.json')
        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)
    new_token = auth.refresh_id_token(refresh_token)
    return new_token

import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import credentials, auth

def password_reset(email):
    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        cred = credentials.Certificate('path/to/serviceAccountKey.json')
        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)
    auth.generate_password_reset_link(email)

import os
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_text(text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

import os
from google.cloud import language_v1 as language

def moderate_profile_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    sentiment_score = analysis.document_sentiment.score
    if sentiment_score < -0.5:
        return 'Profile text rejected due to negative sentiment'
    return 'Profile text accepted'

import os
from google.cloud import language_v1 as language

def summarize_onboarding_state(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_entities(document=document)
    entities = [entity.name for entity in analysis.entities]
    return entities

import os
from google.cloud import firestore

def store_profile_note(user_id, note):
    client = firestore.Client()
    doc_ref = client.collection(u'profile_notes').document(user_id)
    doc_ref.set({'note': note})
